shared_elements: low-relief figures on a tall vertical slab
figure/creature shown in profile facing left
horizontal band of repeating linear pattern (zigzag / wavy line)
raised smooth forms against a flat background
justification: Both are tall vertical slabs bearing low-relief figures in leftward profile combined with a horizontal band of repeating zigzag/wavy line, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. The depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows a stacked assemblage of highly schematic animals (long-necked bird-headed creatures, quadrupeds, a row of arched forms, a serpentine element) in registers, while B shows a single comparatively naturalistic human figure with an elaborate headdress and hair, with the patterned band placed below rather than between animal registers.
